I have written Prolog in 2 public repositories, from 2021 to 2023.

What it was for: [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [MindScape](@/work/mindscape.md); [happ](@/work/happ.md): Playground App created during my Hospital Stay.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Prolog: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Prolog to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
